features: ⚠️ THIS VERSION DOES NOT TOUCH THE DATABASE. It does change how the «Breakdown by Expense Item» report reads: two new columns appear only in buildings that have opening balances or contributions already paid in. Row totals and the grand total are unchanged.

THE BREAKDOWN THAT ADDED UP TWO OPPOSITE THINGS — In the breakdown-by-item report, money already paid in by owners and balances carried over from previous years were added together and dumped onto the largest expense item. They have opposite signs — arrears increase what is owed, money already paid reduces it — so they cancelled each other out and neither was readable any more. On a budget with € 5,000.00 of works, € 2,000.00 already paid and € 1,800.00 of arrears, the «Facade renovation» column printed € 4,800.00: neither the amount the meeting approved, nor the amount being asked for. And the arrears appeared nowhere at all. The grand total still balanced, which is why the defect survived every reconciliation check.

THREE COLUMNS INSTEAD OF ONE MUTE NUMBER — Each item column is now worth the approved budget, and the two quantities each get their own column: «Già versato» (already paid) and «Saldi precedenti» (previous balances). On the same case the report now says what is said at the meeting: the facade costs € 5,000.00, € 2,000.00 has already been paid in, € 3,000.00 is being asked for, plus € 1,800.00 of arrears. The legend explains both columns, including the fact that money already paid follows the unit and not the person (art. 63 disp. att. c.c.).

THE TWO BREAKDOWN REPORTS BEHAVE THE SAME WAY AGAIN — The twin report «by Table» had already stopped putting these amounts onto the thousandths columns, after a real building saw a € 1,000.00 column print € 1,214.36. The by-item report was still doing it. Both now follow the same rule.

WHEN SOMEONE HAS BEEN CHARGED MORE THAN THE BREAKDOWN EXPLAINS, IT SAYS SO — This happens when data is changed after the instalments were generated: the typical case is an owner detached from the unit after issue, who stays charged while no longer holding any thousandths. That amount now goes into the «Fuori riparto» (outside the breakdown) column instead of being hidden inside an expense item, and it is recorded in the system log. Until now this was the only silent case in this report, and it is precisely the one that moves money on a document that goes to the owners' meeting.
